## Classes

### `class MatterBackendAdapterRegistry`

Open bridge registry for PhysX, FEM, MPM, particle, fluid, voxel, aerosol, and future solvers. Backends retain numerical authority; Matter retains the semantic state and validates every collected candidate state.
